Module · MEM

Member Directory / Member Management

Maintain a directory of HOA members and manage member accounts.

Neome App

Employee Directory

Delivery · indicative
Configuration
How

Member → Employee record set up for HOA Members: Name, Phone, Address, Email, Number of Family Members, Number of Cards as fields; status Active / Inactive (exit as status change, record kept); Board Member and Member roles scoped so a Member sees only their own account; login invite as an automation; directory sheet and Headcount report for Board Members; fit for non-employee people to verify (OI-38); Member sees only own account, Board Members the full directory; family members recorded under the primary Member with no separate login; Number of Cards purpose open (OI-05)

Status flow
MEM-01
Member registration form
The member registration form captures Name, Phone and Address (required) and Email, Number of Family Members and Number of Cards (optional).
Acceptance criteria
  • A registration cannot be saved without Name, Phone and Address.
MustNeomeRFP-1, QA-1OI-02 OI-03 OI-04 OI-05 OI-37
MEM-02
Member account scope
Each registered member has access only to the information associated with their own account.
Acceptance criteria
  • A Member cannot open another Member's account information.
MustNeomeRFP-1, QA-1OI-01 OI-37
MEM-03
Complete directory for Board Members
Board Members can view the complete member directory.
Acceptance criteria
  • Board Members see all registered members.
MustNeomeStandardRFP-1, QA-1OI-01 OI-37
MEM-04
Member onboarding
A new member is registered, gets a member account, is added to the HOA directory, and then gets access to the relevant modules.
Acceptance criteria
  • After registration, the member sees exactly the modules their role allows.
MustNeomeRFP-1, QA-1OI-04 OI-37
MEM-05
Manage member information
Board Members can manage member information (add and update members).
Acceptance criteria
  • Board Members can manage HOA members.
  • Members cannot add or edit member records.
MustNeomeRFP-1, QA-1OI-03 OI-37
MEM-06
Member status
A Member is Active or Inactive; a Board Member sets a Member Inactive when they move out or sell, the record is kept and their login stops.
Acceptance criteria
  • An Inactive Member cannot log in and still shows in the Board Members' directory with status Inactive.
  • A Member record cannot be deleted.
ShouldNeomeQA-1OI-35 OI-37
MEM-07
Login invite on registration
When a Board Member registers a Member, no approval is needed and the Member gets a login invite.
Acceptance criteria
  • A newly registered Member receives a login invite without any approval step.
ShouldNeomeQA-1OI-23 OI-36 OI-37
MEM-08
Total number of members
Board Members see the total number of Members.
Acceptance criteria
  • A Board Member sees the count of Members, split by Active and Inactive.
CouldNeomeStandardRFP-1, QA-1OI-26 OI-37

No Requirements match.

Module · ANN

Announcements

Let the HOA Board communicate important information to Society Members.

Neome App

Internal Community Forum

Delivery · indicative
Configuration
How

General Announcement → Forum post in an Announcements category; Event / Party Announcement → post in an Events category with event fields (no RSVP, so no Event Management ); only Board Members may post, Members read-only; no pre-publish approval; Draft / Published / Archived stages; new-post Neome app notification to Members; Upcoming events list for Board Members; HOA Members as people who are not employees (OI-38)

Status flow
ANN-01
General announcements
Board Members can create announcements, publish them, and view previously published announcements.
Acceptance criteria
  • Board Members can create and publish announcements.
  • Members can view announcements but cannot modify them.
MustNeomeRFP-1, QA-1OI-37
ANN-02
Member read-only access
Members have read-only access to announcements and cannot create, modify, or delete them.
Acceptance criteria
  • A Member is offered no create, edit or delete action on any announcement.
MustNeomeRFP-1, QA-1OI-37
ANN-03
Event and party announcements
Board Members can publish party or event-related announcements through a separate form.
Acceptance criteria
  • The event / party form is separate from the general announcement form.
  • The form holds Event title, Event description, Event date, Start time, End time, Venue / location and Contact person; Event title and Event date are required.
MustNeomeRFP-1, QA-1OI-06 OI-07 OI-37
ANN-04
General announcement form
A General Announcement holds Title, Message and Publish date (required) and an optional Attachment.
Acceptance criteria
  • A General Announcement cannot be published without Title and Message.
MustNeomeQA-1OI-40 OI-37
ANN-05
Announcement stages
An announcement moves Draft → Published → Archived; a Board Member can edit or archive a published announcement, and an Event / Party Announcement archives after its event date.
Acceptance criteria
  • A Draft is not visible to Members.
  • An Archived announcement no longer shows in the Members' current list and is not deleted.
ShouldNeomeQA-1OI-42 OI-37
ANN-06
Publish without approval
Any Board Member can publish an announcement without another Board Member's approval.
Acceptance criteria
  • A Board Member's publish makes the announcement visible to Members at once.
ShouldNeomeQA-1OI-41 OI-37
ANN-07
New announcement and event notifications
Members are notified when a new announcement or a new Event / Party Announcement is published.
Acceptance criteria
  • On publish, every Member gets a Neome app notification.
ShouldNeome, TBCRFP-1, QA-1OI-08 OI-23 OI-37
ANN-08
Upcoming events
Board Members see a list of upcoming events.
Acceptance criteria
  • A Board Member sees Event / Party Announcements with an event date from today, soonest first.
CouldNeomeRFP-1, QA-1OI-26 OI-37

No Requirements match.

Module · TKT

Tickets

Let Members report HOA-related concerns or requests and let Board Members resolve them.

Neome App

Ticketing & Task Management

Delivery · indicative
Configuration
How

Ticket → Ticket with HOA categories (Maintenance / Landscaping / Security / Noise / Other) and fields Ticket title, Category, Description, Attachment / photo, Date, Priority; own stages Open / In Progress / Resolved / Closed; raiser = Member, who sees only own tickets; Board Members as one shared queue, no assignment, SLA or approval; Ticket update → ticket comments and status history; status-change, response and new-ticket notifications by Neome app notification only; Open tickets and Tickets by status reports; close without reopen; HOA Members as people who are not employees (OI-38)

Status flow
TKT-01
Raise tickets
Members can create tickets related to community or HOA matters.
Acceptance criteria
  • Members can raise HOA-related tickets.
  • A ticket cannot be saved without Ticket title, Category and Description.
MustNeomeRFP-1, QA-1OI-09 OI-12 OI-37
TKT-02
Member ticket view
A Member sees only the tickets they created, can track their status, and can view responses or updates provided by Board Members.
Acceptance criteria
  • Members can view only their own tickets.
MustNeomeRFP-1, QA-1OI-11 OI-37
TKT-03
Board ticket handling
Board Members can view all tickets submitted by all members, review ticket details, act on tickets, update ticket status, and provide updates or comments.
Acceptance criteria
  • Board Members can view and manage all tickets.
MustNeomeRFP-1, QA-1OI-37
TKT-04
Ticket lifecycle
Ticket status moves through Open, In Progress, Resolved and Closed.
Acceptance criteria
  • Every ticket is in exactly one of the four statuses at any time.
  • Only a Board Member can change a ticket's status.
MustNeomeRFP-1, QA-1OI-10 OI-45 OI-37
TKT-05
Ticket updates and comments
Board Members add updates or comments on a ticket, and the Member who raised it sees them on the ticket.
Acceptance criteria
  • Each update shows who wrote it and when.
  • A Member sees every Board update on their own ticket.
MustNeomeRFP-1, QA-1OI-11 OI-37
TKT-06
Ticket notifications
The Member who raised a ticket is notified when its status changes or a Board Member responds.
Acceptance criteria
  • On a status change or new Board update, the Member gets a notification on the agreed channel.
  • Board Members are notified when a new ticket is raised.
ShouldNeome, TBCRFP-1, QA-1OI-13 OI-23 OI-37
TKT-07
Shared Board queue
Tickets are not assigned to one Board Member; any Board Member can pick up and act on any ticket, with no approval step.
Acceptance criteria
  • Every Board Member sees every Open ticket and can move it to In Progress.
ShouldNeomeQA-1OI-46 OI-37
TKT-08
Close without reopen
A Board Member closes a resolved ticket; a closed ticket is not reopened, and a Member who is not satisfied raises a new ticket.
Acceptance criteria
  • A Closed ticket offers no status change.
ShouldNeomeQA-1OI-45 OI-37
TKT-09
Ticket dashboard
Board Members see open tickets and tickets by status.
Acceptance criteria
  • A Board Member sees the count of tickets per status and the list of tickets not Closed.
CouldNeomeRFP-1, QA-1OI-26 OI-37

No Requirements match.

Module · RPAY

Raise Payment

Let Board Members raise a payment for a list of Members; each raise creates one Payment entry per listed Member.

Neome App

No catalog App (custom)

Delivery · indicative
Custom
How

Raise Payment → new record built on the Neome platform: form with Payment title, Description, Amount, Due date, Payment category master list (Annual dues / Special assessment / Other), Applicable members picked from the Member Directory with select all (Employee Directory people, OI-38); stages Draft / Raised / Cancelled, no approval; on save a workflow automation creates one Payment entry per Member and sends the new payment request notification by Neome app notification; raises list as a sheet with filters; no payment gateway

Status flow
RPAY-01
Raise Payment
Board Members can create a payment request / collection for HOA members.
Acceptance criteria
  • Board Members can raise payment collections.
  • A Member has no raise action.
  • A raise cannot be saved without Payment title, Amount, Due date and at least one Member.
MustNeomeRFP-1, QA-1OI-18 OI-37
RPAY-02
One Payment entry per listed Member
Each raise holds a list of Members and inserts one entry per listed Member into Payment.
Acceptance criteria
  • Saving a raise for N Members creates N Payment entries, one per Member, with the raise's amount and due date.
MustNeomeWS-1, QA-1OI-37
RPAY-03
Pick Members, or all
The Board Member picks the Members for a raise from the member list, or picks all Members; there is no limit on Members per raise.
Acceptance criteria
  • One action selects every Member.
  • Only Members in the Member Directory can be picked.
MustNeomeWS-2, QA-1OI-37
RPAY-04
Raise stages and cancel
A raise moves Draft → Raised with no second Board Member approval, and a Board Member can cancel it, which cancels its unpaid Payment entries.
Acceptance criteria
  • A Draft raise creates no Payment entries.
  • Cancelling a raise cancels every unpaid entry; paid entries stay.
ShouldNeomeQA-1OI-50 OI-49 OI-37
RPAY-05
New payment request notification
Each listed Member is notified when a payment is raised for them.
Acceptance criteria
  • On saving a raise, every listed Member gets a notification on the agreed channel.
ShouldNeome, TBCRFP-1, QA-1OI-17 OI-23 OI-37
RPAY-06
Raises list
Board Members see a list of raises with category, due date, Members count and total amount.
Acceptance criteria
  • A Board Member can filter raises by category and due date.
CouldNeomeQA-1OI-26 OI-37

No Requirements match.

Module · PAY

Payment

Track one Payment entry per Member per raise: Members see their own and get reminders; Board Members see all and record payment. No online payment.

Neome App

No catalog App (custom)

Delivery · indicative
Custom
How

Payment → new record built on the Neome platform, created by the Raise Payment workflow, one per Member (Member Directory people, OI-38); fields incl. paid date, method master list, reference, proof of payment file; stages Pending / Overdue / Paid / Waived / Cancelled with Board-only actions and audit trail; reminder automations (one month before due, weekly overdue) and payment received notification by Neome app notification only; invoice PDF per entry; Member sheet scoped to own entries, Board sheet and dashboard; no payment gateway

Status flow
PAY-01
Member payment view
Each Member can view their current pending payments, upcoming payments, previous payment history, payment amount and payment status, for their own account only.
Acceptance criteria
  • Members can view their pending payments and payment history.
  • A Member cannot see another Member's payment information.
MustNeomeRFP-1, WS-3
PAY-02
Payment reminder
Members receive a reminder for upcoming payments approximately one month before the payment due date, by Neome app notification only.
Acceptance criteria
  • Members receive upcoming payment reminders about one month before the due date, as a Neome app notification; no email is sent.
MustNeomeRFP-1, WS-3, QA-1
PAY-03
Board payment overview
Board Members can view payments for all members, see paid, pending and overdue payments separately, and track payment status.
Acceptance criteria
  • Board Members can monitor paid, pending and overdue payments.
MustNeomeRFP-1, WS-3
PAY-05
Payment tracking only
The system only tracks Payment entries; Members do not pay online and there is no payment gateway.
Acceptance criteria
  • No Payment screen offers an online pay action.
MustNeomeWS-1, WS-3
PAY-06
Board Member records payment received
A Board Member marks a Member's Payment entry as Paid, recording paid date, payment method, an optional reference number and a proof of payment document.
Acceptance criteria
  • Once marked Paid, the entry moves from pending to paid in the Member's payment history.
  • The proof of payment document is visible to Board Members and to the entry's own Member only.
MustNeomeWS-1, WS-3OI-28 OI-53
PAY-07
Only Board changes status
Only Board Members can change a Payment entry's status.
Acceptance criteria
  • A Member has no status action on any Payment entry.
MustNeomeWS-3
PAY-08
Payment stages
A Payment entry moves Pending → Overdue automatically after the due date, and ends Paid, Waived (with a reason) or Cancelled (raise cancelled); part payment is not allowed.
Acceptance criteria
  • An unpaid entry shows Overdue the day after its due date.
  • Waived needs a reason.
  • An entry cannot be marked paid for part of its amount.
MustNeomeWS-3
PAY-09
Download invoice
A Member can download a PDF invoice for each of their Payment entries.
Acceptance criteria
  • The invoice shows HOA name, Member, title, amount, due date and status; once Paid it adds paid date and method.
ShouldNeomeWS-3
PAY-10
Overdue reminder
A Member receives an overdue reminder weekly after the due date until the entry is Paid, Waived or Cancelled.
Acceptance criteria
  • Reminders stop once the entry is Paid, Waived or Cancelled.
ShouldNeomeWS-3OI-16
PAY-11
Payment received notification
A Member is notified when a Board Member marks their Payment entry Paid.
Acceptance criteria
  • The Member gets a Neome app notification when the entry is marked Paid; no email is sent.
ShouldNeomeWS-3, QA-1
PAY-12
Board payment dashboard
Board Members see total due, collected, pending and overdue amounts, by raise and by Member, and an overdue list.
Acceptance criteria
  • A Board Member can filter the dashboard by raise and by Member.
ShouldNeomeRFP-1, WS-3
PAY-13
Undo wrong Paid
A Board Member can set a wrongly Paid entry back to Pending or Overdue with a reason; the change is logged.
Acceptance criteria
  • The log shows who changed it, when and why.
ShouldNeomeWS-3
PAY-14
Keep payment records
Payment entries, proof of payment documents and status changes are kept with no time limit.
Acceptance criteria
  • A Board Member can open any past Payment entry with its proof and change log.
MustNeomeWS-3, QA-1OI-37
PAY-04
Raise payment collection Withdrawn
Board Members can create a payment request / collection for HOA members.
Withdrawn: Moved to RPAY-01
Acceptance criteria
  • Board Members can raise payment collections.
TBCOpenRFP-1OI-18

Module · VEN

Vendors

Maintain a directory of vendors used or recommended by the HOA.

Neome App

Purchase Management

Delivery · indicative
Configuration
How

Vendor → Vendor (vendor master) only, no purchase requests or orders; Service Type / Category as a master list; Government ID Proof as a restricted document field seen by Board Members only, kept forever (no delete; encryption at rest is platform standard); Active / Inactive stages; Members read-only with a category filter on Active vendors; HOA Members as people who are not employees (OI-38); hangs on OI-58

Status flow
VEN-01
Vendor directory fields
The vendor directory records Vendor Name, Service Type / Category, Contact Number and Government ID Proof (required) and Email, Address and Additional Notes (optional).
Acceptance criteria
  • A vendor cannot be saved without Vendor Name, Service Type / Category, Contact Number and Government ID Proof.
MustNeomeRFP-1, QA-1OI-19 OI-37
VEN-02
Vendor management
Board Members can add vendors, view vendors, update vendor information, and maintain vendor documents and identification details.
Acceptance criteria
  • Board Members can maintain the vendor directory.
MustNeomeRFP-1, QA-1OI-37
VEN-03
Member read-only vendor directory
Members have read-only access to the vendor directory.
Acceptance criteria
  • Members can access the approved vendor directory.
  • A Member is offered no add or edit action on any vendor.
MustNeomeRFP-1, QA-1OI-20 OI-37
VEN-04
Government ID Proof restricted
Government ID Proof holds sensitive personal information and is shown to Board Members only.
Acceptance criteria
  • A Member viewing a vendor does not see or download its Government ID Proof.
  • Government ID Proof is kept forever and stays secured in Neome.
MustNeome, TBCRFP-1, QA-1, QA-2OI-20 OI-21 OI-25 OI-37
VEN-05
Service categories
Service Type / Category is picked from a fixed list: Landscaping, Plumber, Electrician, Maintenance, Other.
Acceptance criteria
  • A Board Member picks one category per vendor from the list.
ShouldNeomeRFP-1, QA-1OI-56 OI-37
VEN-06
Vendor stages
A vendor is Active or Inactive; a Board Member sets a vendor Inactive when the HOA stops using it, and Members see Active vendors only.
Acceptance criteria
  • An Inactive vendor does not show in the Members' directory and is not deleted.
  • A Board Member can set an Inactive vendor Active again.
ShouldNeomeQA-1OI-55 OI-37
VEN-07
Find vendors by category
Board Members and Members can filter the vendor directory by Service Type / Category.
Acceptance criteria
  • Picking a category lists only Active vendors of that category.
CouldNeomeQA-1OI-56 OI-37

Glossary

Deans Pond HOA terms used in this document

TermMeaning at Deans Pond HOASources
HOAproposed, to confirmThe Homeowners Association in the USA whose Board Members and Members use the solution.RFP-1
Board Memberproposed, to confirmA HOA role with administrative access: manages announcements, tickets, payments, the vendor directory and member information.
Avoid: Admin
RFP-1
Memberproposed, to confirmA HOA role with limited access, based on their own account. The BRD also calls this role "Society Member".
Avoid: Society Member
RFP-1
Member Directoryproposed, to confirmThe directory of HOA members.
Avoid: HOA Directory
RFP-1
General Announcementproposed, to confirmInformation the Board publishes for Members (not event or party related).RFP-1
Event / Party Announcementproposed, to confirmA separate announcement form the Board uses to publish party or event-related information.RFP-1
Ticketproposed, to confirmA Member's report of an HOA-related concern or request, handled by Board Members.RFP-1
Raise Paymentproposed, to confirmA payment request the Board raises for a list of HOA Members; each raise creates one Payment per listed Member.
Avoid: Payment request, Payment Collection
RFP-1, WS-1
Paymentproposed, to confirmOne Member's payment entry, created from a Raise Payment. Tracked only; Members do not pay online.RFP-1, WS-1
Payment Reminderproposed, to confirmA reminder a Member receives for an upcoming payment, approximately one month before the due date.RFP-1
Overdue Reminderproposed, to confirmA weekly reminder a Member receives after the due date until the Payment is Paid, Waived or Cancelled.WS-3
Proof of paymentproposed, to confirmA document a Board Member uploads when recording a Payment as Paid; seen by Board Members and the entry's own Member only.WS-3
Invoiceproposed, to confirmA PDF a Member downloads for one Payment: HOA name, Member, title, amount, due date, status; once Paid it adds paid date and method.WS-3
Vendorproposed, to confirmA service provider used or recommended by the HOA, listed in the vendor directory (grass cutting / landscaping, plumber, electrician, maintenance and other HOA service providers).RFP-1
Government ID Proofproposed, to confirmA government identity document collected for each vendor; contains sensitive personal information.RFP-1

How Neome delivers each Module

Neome App and Delivery are indicative, from the public catalog.

ModuleWhat it coversHow Neome delivers itNeome AppDelivery
MEMMember Directory / Member ManagementMaintain a directory of HOA members and manage member accounts.Member → Employee record set up for HOA Members: Name, Phone, Address, Email, Number of Family Members, Number of Cards as fields; status Active / Inactive (exit as status change, record kept); Board Member and Member roles scoped so a Member sees only their own account; login invite as an automation; directory sheet and Headcount report for Board Members; fit for non-employee people to verify (OI-38); Member sees only own account, Board Members the full directory; family members recorded under the primary Member with no separate login; Number of Cards purpose open (OI-05)Employee DirectoryConfiguration
ANNAnnouncementsLet the HOA Board communicate important information to Society Members.General Announcement → Forum post in an Announcements category; Event / Party Announcement → post in an Events category with event fields (no RSVP, so no Event Management ); only Board Members may post, Members read-only; no pre-publish approval; Draft / Published / Archived stages; new-post Neome app notification to Members; Upcoming events list for Board Members; HOA Members as people who are not employees (OI-38)Internal Community ForumConfiguration
TKTTicketsLet Members report HOA-related concerns or requests and let Board Members resolve them.Ticket → Ticket with HOA categories (Maintenance / Landscaping / Security / Noise / Other) and fields Ticket title, Category, Description, Attachment / photo, Date, Priority; own stages Open / In Progress / Resolved / Closed; raiser = Member, who sees only own tickets; Board Members as one shared queue, no assignment, SLA or approval; Ticket update → ticket comments and status history; status-change, response and new-ticket notifications by Neome app notification only; Open tickets and Tickets by status reports; close without reopen; HOA Members as people who are not employees (OI-38)Ticketing & Task ManagementConfiguration
RPAYRaise PaymentLet Board Members raise a payment for a list of Members; each raise creates one Payment entry per listed Member.Raise Payment → new record built on the Neome platform: form with Payment title, Description, Amount, Due date, Payment category master list (Annual dues / Special assessment / Other), Applicable members picked from the Member Directory with select all (Employee Directory people, OI-38); stages Draft / Raised / Cancelled, no approval; on save a workflow automation creates one Payment entry per Member and sends the new payment request notification by Neome app notification; raises list as a sheet with filters; no payment gatewayNo catalog App (custom)Custom
PAYPaymentTrack one Payment entry per Member per raise: Members see their own and get reminders; Board Members see all and record payment. No online payment.Payment → new record built on the Neome platform, created by the Raise Payment workflow, one per Member (Member Directory people, OI-38); fields incl. paid date, method master list, reference, proof of payment file; stages Pending / Overdue / Paid / Waived / Cancelled with Board-only actions and audit trail; reminder automations (one month before due, weekly overdue) and payment received notification by Neome app notification only; invoice PDF per entry; Member sheet scoped to own entries, Board sheet and dashboard; no payment gatewayNo catalog App (custom)Custom
VENVendorsMaintain a directory of vendors used or recommended by the HOA.Vendor → Vendor (vendor master) only, no purchase requests or orders; Service Type / Category as a master list; Government ID Proof as a restricted document field seen by Board Members only, kept forever (no delete; encryption at rest is platform standard); Active / Inactive stages; Members read-only with a category filter on Active vendors; HOA Members as people who are not employees (OI-38); hangs on OI-58Purchase ManagementConfiguration

Glossary

Deans Pond HOA terms used in this document

TermMeaning at Deans Pond HOASources
HOAproposed, to confirmThe Homeowners Association in the USA whose Board Members and Members use the solution.RFP-1
Board Memberproposed, to confirmA HOA role with administrative access: manages announcements, tickets, payments, the vendor directory and member information.
Avoid: Admin
RFP-1
Memberproposed, to confirmA HOA role with limited access, based on their own account. The BRD also calls this role "Society Member".
Avoid: Society Member
RFP-1
Member Directoryproposed, to confirmThe directory of HOA members.
Avoid: HOA Directory
RFP-1
General Announcementproposed, to confirmInformation the Board publishes for Members (not event or party related).RFP-1
Event / Party Announcementproposed, to confirmA separate announcement form the Board uses to publish party or event-related information.RFP-1
Ticketproposed, to confirmA Member's report of an HOA-related concern or request, handled by Board Members.RFP-1
Raise Paymentproposed, to confirmA payment request the Board raises for a list of HOA Members; each raise creates one Payment per listed Member.
Avoid: Payment request, Payment Collection
RFP-1, WS-1
Paymentproposed, to confirmOne Member's payment entry, created from a Raise Payment. Tracked only; Members do not pay online.RFP-1, WS-1
Payment Reminderproposed, to confirmA reminder a Member receives for an upcoming payment, approximately one month before the due date.RFP-1
Overdue Reminderproposed, to confirmA weekly reminder a Member receives after the due date until the Payment is Paid, Waived or Cancelled.WS-3
Proof of paymentproposed, to confirmA document a Board Member uploads when recording a Payment as Paid; seen by Board Members and the entry's own Member only.WS-3
Invoiceproposed, to confirmA PDF a Member downloads for one Payment: HOA name, Member, title, amount, due date, status; once Paid it adds paid date and method.WS-3
Vendorproposed, to confirmA service provider used or recommended by the HOA, listed in the vendor directory (grass cutting / landscaping, plumber, electrician, maintenance and other HOA service providers).RFP-1
Government ID Proofproposed, to confirmA government identity document collected for each vendor; contains sensitive personal information.RFP-1
